name: SQL Injection
description: Potential SQL Injection: String interpolation used in database query method. Use parameterized queries instead.
remediation: Replace string interpolation with parameterized queries. Use positional arguments (?) in rawQuery/rawInsert/rawDelete/rawUpdate.

name: Command Injection
description: Potential Command Injection: User input may be passed to a system process execution method.
remediation: Never pass unsanitized user input to Process.run or Process.start. Use allow-lists for permitted commands and validate all arguments.

name: Unsafe File Upload
description: File upload method called without allowedExtensions filter. Unrestricted file types may lead to malicious file uploads.
remediation: Always specify allowedExtensions when using file picker methods to restrict accepted file types (e.g., ['jpg', 'png', 'pdf']).

name: Deep Link Poisoning
description: Deep link URI obtained without validation. Malicious URIs can redirect users or inject parameters.
remediation: Validate and sanitize all deep link parameters before use. Check URI scheme, host, and path against an allow-list.

name: Missing Form Validation
description: TextFormField created without a validator function. User input will not be validated before submission.
remediation: Add a validator parameter to TextFormField that checks input format, length, and content. Use RegExp for email, phone, and other structured inputs.
